en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Sinan, from Sabiq Bin Al Waleed, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays that, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘Hameeda is as refined from the pollution like and ingot of gold. The Angels did not cease to guard her until she was to me<sup>asws</sup> as a prestige from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for me, and the Divine Authority from after me<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from ‘Abdallah ibn Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Husayn from ibn Sinan from Sabiq ibn al-Walid from al-Mu‘alla ibn Khunays who has said the following. “Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said,

“Humayda is clean of uncleanliness like purified gold. The angels continuously guarded her until she reach me due to Allah’s regards for me and the possessor of Leadership with Divine Authority after me.”
